description: This file defines a Drupal Views field plugin class 'HistoryUserTimestamp' that handles displaying timestamps related to user activity and content changes, including comments, for nodes in the Drupal CMS.

classes.name: HistoryUserTimestamp
classes.description: A Drupal Views field plugin class for displaying user timestamp information related to content and comments.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the field uses SQL GROUP BY clause; returns FALSE.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, adding additional fields based on user authentication and comment module status.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines plugin options, including a 'comments' checkbox option.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form, adding a checkbox for comments if the comment module exists.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the query to only run if the user is logged in.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the timestamp marker based on user activity, content changes, and comments.
